newsitem.title: USA: OMB's Raines says U.S. economic expansion solid.
newsitem.headline: OMB's Raines says U.S. economic expansion solid.

text.p: Office of Management and Budget Director Franklin Raines said Wednesday the U.S. economic expansion was solid and he did not foresee any factors on the horizon to threaten it.

"Generally speaking, the major economic indicators today suggest that this expansion is extraordinarily solid, and can continue for some time," Raines said in testimony prepared for a hearing of Congress' Joint Economic Committee.
The economy is "remarkably sound," he said. "Though we have not abolished the business cycle, no problem on the horizon threatens the current expansion," Raines added.

He repeated that with surprising strength shown in the recent fourth quarter gross domestic product figures, the administration expects, if anything, that the economy will continue to outperform its projections.
